title: Natural tensor comparison on K-flat cochain representatives before localization
statement: Let g:T\to X be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with recorded derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], tensors [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure] and derived pullback L [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Let F be an additive functor on module sheaves, with object equalities h_M:F(M)=g^*M and morphism equalities F(a)=h_M;g^*(a);h_N inverse for the tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Let epsilon:Qh L\to K(F) Qh exhibit L as a left-derived functor for quasi-isomorphisms. For each cochain pair P,N let phi(P,N):F Tot(P tensor N)\cong Tot(FP tensor FN) be an isomorphism natural simultaneously in both complex maps, meaning F Tot(a tensor b);phi(P',N')=phi(P,N);Tot(Fa tensor Fb). Suppose epsilon_Tot(P tensor N);Q(phi(P,N)) is invertible on every K-flat pair [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Then there is an isomorphism e(P,N):L(QP) tensor L(QN)\cong L(QP tensor QN) for every K-flat pair, satisfying e;L(mu_Q);epsilon_tensor;Q(phi)=(epsilon_P tensor epsilon_N);mu_Q(FP,FN), and simultaneously natural in all cochain maps between K-flat pairs. No localization of the K-flat subcategory, or comparison on arbitrary derived objects, is asserted.

proof.text: Identify the supplied additive F with the recorded tensor pullback. K-flat preservation identifies the images of K-flat complexes with K-flat complexes. Compare the supplied derived counit with the recorded K-flat computation by uniqueness of left-derived functors; it is invertible on K-flat objects.

For a K-flat pair the localization tensorator on X is invertible; the counits on each factor and the tensorator on the F-images are invertible by K-flat preservation and the K-flat tensor computation. Write A=L(mu_Q), B=epsilon_tensor;Q(phi), C=(epsilon_P tensor epsilon_N);mu_Q(FP,FN). The hypothesis gives invertibility of B. Form e=C;B inverse;A inverse, and cancellation proves e;A;B=C. No tensor-product K-flatness theorem is needed here because B invertibility is explicitly assumed.

Use naturality of epsilon, phi and both localization tensorators to check the component formula is simultaneously natural in cochain maps. Postcompose both sides by the invertible target comparison and cancel. This stops before extending the family to derived bifunctors.

theorem derivedPullback_kFlat_tensor_model {T X : Scheme.{uModel}} (g : T ⟶ X)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wModel} (SheafOfModules.{uModel} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wModel} (SheafOfModules.{uModel} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace))]
    (F : SheafOfModules.{uModel} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{uModel} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace))
    (hF : ∀ M, F.obj M = Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj g M)
    (hmap : ∀ {M N} (a : M ⟶ N),
      F.map a = eqToHom (hF M) ≫ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackMap g a ≫
        eqToHom (hF N).symm)
    [F.Additive]
    (ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ derivedPullback g ⟶
      F.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh)
    (hε : (derivedPullback g).IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
        (SheafOfModules.{uModel} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    (φ : ∀ P N : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{uModel} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ,
        (F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
            (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P N (curriedTensor _)) ≅
          CochainComplex.mapBifunctor
            ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P)
            ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj N) (curriedTensor _))
    (hnatural : ∀ (P P' N N' : CochainComplex
              (SheafOfModules.{uModel} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
            (a : P ⟶ P') (b : N ⟶ N'),
          (F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
              (HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap a b (curriedTensor _) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ≫
              (φ P' N').hom =
            (φ P N).hom ≫
              HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap
                ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map a)
                ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map b) (curriedTensor _)
                (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
    (hiso : ∀ P N : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{uModel} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ,
          CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf) P → CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf) N →
            IsIso (ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
                (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P N (curriedTensor _))) ≫
              DerivedCategory.Qh.map ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map
                (φ P N).hom)))
    : ∃ e : ∀ (P N : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{uModel} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ),
        CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf) P →
        CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf) N →
          (((derivedPullback g).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ⊗
            (derivedPullback g).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj N)) ≅
          (derivedPullback g).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ⊗ DerivedCategory.Q.obj N)),
      (∀ (P N : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{uModel} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
        (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf) P)
        (hN : CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf) N),
        (e P N hP hN).hom ≫
            (derivedPullback g).map (Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ DerivedCategory.Q P N) ≫
            ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj
              (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P N (curriedTensor _))) ≫
            DerivedCategory.Q.map (φ P N).hom =
          (ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P) ⊗ₘ
            ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj N)) ≫
            Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ DerivedCategory.Q
              ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
              ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj N)) ∧
      (∀ (P P' N N' : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{uModel} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
        (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf) P)
        (hP' : CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf) P')
        (hN : CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf) N)
        (hN' : CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := X.sheaf) N') (a : P ⟶ P') (b : N ⟶ N'),
        ((curriedTensorPre (derivedPullback g)).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map a)).app
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj N) ≫
            ((curriedTensorPre (derivedPullback g)).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P')).map
              (DerivedCategory.Q.map b) ≫ (e P' N' hP' hN').hom =
          (e P N hP hN).hom ≫
            ((curriedTensorPost (derivedPullback g)).map (DerivedCategory.Q.map a)).app
              (DerivedCategory.Q.obj N) ≫
            ((curriedTensorPost (derivedPullback g)).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P')).map
              (DerivedCategory.Q.map b))
